skill.summary: Build healthy eating habits with meal logging, nutrition tracking, and food choices

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the healthy-eating skill:

- Log meals, including portion size and meal context, to build sustainable eating habits.
- Get healthy meal suggestions and quick swaps based on your preferences or available ingredients.
- Check nutrition information, including nutrient breakdown and hydration status, without calorie counting.
- Plan and track meals effortlessly, with support for weekly planning and batch prep.
- View and celebrate habit patterns over time, keeping your data private and local.
